# Exact dependency versions CI installs, so every run resolves the same code
# and a local environment can be made to match with:
#
#     pip install -e ".[dev]" -c .github/ci-constraints.txt
#
# pyproject.toml declares the supported *range*; this file picks the single
# version CI actually tests against. Bump it deliberately, after running the
# suite on the new release -- not implicitly on whatever the resolver picks.
#
# optuna: 5.0 changed get_param_importances() to return an empty mapping where
# it previously raised, which plot_param_importance depended on. An unpinned CI
# picked that up on release day while local environments stayed on 4.x.
optuna==5.0.0
